import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from scipy.sparse import hstack
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Prepare features and labels
X_train = train_df["text"].values
y_train = train_df["author"].values
X_test = test_df["text"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Stratified train-validation split
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Character-level TF-IDF vectorizer (1-7 n-grams) with sublinear_tf - IMPROVED from (1,6)
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(1, 7),
    max_features=200000,
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.9,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

# Word-level TF-IDF vectorizer (1-3 n-grams) with sublinear_tf
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word",
    ngram_range=(1, 3),
    max_features=150000,
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.9,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

# Fit and transform training data
X_tr_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_tr)
X_tr_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_tr)
X_tr_combined = hstack([X_tr_char, X_tr_word])

X_val_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_val_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_val_combined = hstack([X_val_char, X_val_word])

# Train LinearSVC with probability calibration using isotonic regression
# cv=10 for more stable probability estimates
base_clf = LinearSVC(random_state=42, max_iter=5000, C=1.0)
clf = CalibratedClassifierCV(base_clf, cv=10, method="isotonic")
clf.fit(X_tr_combined, y_tr)

# Validate on hold-out set
y_val_pred = clf.predict_proba(X_val_combined)
val_log_loss = log_loss(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation Multi-class Log Loss: {val_log_loss}")

# Retrain on full training data
X_train_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_train_combined = hstack([X_train_char, X_train_word])

clf_full = CalibratedClassifierCV(
    LinearSVC(random_state=42, max_iter=5000, C=1.0), cv=10, method="isotonic"
)
clf_full.fit(X_train_combined, y_train)

# Predict on test set
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_test)
X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_test)
X_test_combined = hstack([X_test_char, X_test_word])
test_pred_proba = clf_full.predict_proba(X_test_combined)

# Create submission dataframe
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_ids,
        "EAP": test_pred_proba[:, 0],
        "HPL": test_pred_proba[:, 1],
        "MWS": test_pred_proba[:, 2],
    }
)

# Ensure correct column order
submission = submission[["id", "EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]]

# Save submission
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
